body: Ad-hoc self-signed HTTPS Flask dev server (server/dev_tls_server.py), bound 0.0.0.0:8723, separate DB from the plain-HTTP dev server, so Android/web clients under development can hit a real HTTPS endpoint (needed e.g. for App Link https scheme testing). User-requested directly, not from the original ticket plan.
title: Minimal TLS-enabled dev server for client-side testing on port 8723
